title: Abhi Microfinance Bank Makes Its Debut on the Pakistan Stock Exchange Under Ticker Symbol ABHI

body_markdown:
**Karachi, Pakistan – 24 November 2026:** Abhi Microfinance Bank officially commenced trading on the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) today under the ticker symbol **ABHI** , marking a significant milestone in the evolution of Pakistan’s financial services sector.


The occasion was marked by a gong ceremony at the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX), attended by Zeeshan R. Khattak, Commissioner, Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP); Farrukh Sabzwari, CEO, Pakistan Stock Exchange; and investors representing Vostok Emerging Finance (VEF) and Speedinvest, alongside Abhi Microfinance Bank’s leadership, partners, and other distinguished guests from the financial community.


The successful listing follows the Bank’s Initial Public Offering (IPO), which comprised 132 million ordinary shares, with 75% allocated to institutional investors through book building and 25% to the general public. The book-building portion was oversubscribed 1.6 times, while the public subscription achieved 100% subscription. The shares were offered at a final price of PKR 15.50 per share.


Commenting on the milestone, **Omair Ansari, CEO of Abhi** , said:


*“Today marks a defining moment in Abhi’s journey. What began in 2021 as a fintech with a vision to make financial access a right, not a privilege, has evolved into a publicly listed microfinance bank. Our listing on the Pakistan Stock Exchange is not just a milestone, but a foundation for the next phase of our growth and our ambition to make financial services more accessible and inclusive across Pakistan.*


*We are grateful to our investors for their confidence in our vision and extend our sincere thanks to the Pakistan Stock Exchange and SECP for their support in making this milestone possible. This is only the beginning.”*


The listing represents an important chapter in Abhi’s journey, which began in 2021 as a fintech focused on Earned Wage Access (EWA). In 2025, Abhi acquired FINCA Microfinance Bank, transforming it into Abhi Microfinance Bank and extending its reach through a regulated banking platform. Today, AMB operates through more than 110 branches across over 100 cities in Pakistan, combining the reach of a microfinance bank with the technology and operational agility of a fintech.


As a publicly listed institution, Abhi Microfinance Bank aims to further strengthen its governance, transparency, and institutional capabilities while expanding access to financial services for underserved individuals, entrepreneurs, and small businesses across Pakistan.


The milestone reinforces Abhi’s broader vision of making financial access a right rather than a privilege.
